source: Transcribed from the R&S RTB2000 Digital Oscilloscope User Manual (1333.1611.02, version 09), whose Remote Control Commands chapter also covers the RTM3000 and RTA4000. Cross-checked against pymeasure rohdeschwarz and QCoDeS rohde_schwarz drivers. Read back against that manual in August 2026, and then against the RTM3000 User Manual (1335.9090.02 version 10) for the models it also covers. 36 entries were absent from the RTB2000 manual; 15 of those are documented in the RTM3000 one. Ten more were not commands at all — BUS, RUNT, TIME, ID and IDDT, with their query forms: rows of a parameter-value table, whose value name and explanation the extractor read as a command and its description. Those are removed. The remaining seven were then found in the RTA4000 User Manual (1335.7898.02), the third instrument the chapter covers: TRIGger:A:LEVel<n>:HYSTeresis and its query, DISPlay:INTensity:BACKlight and its query, WGENerator:OUTPut:DESTination and its query, and CURSor<m>:SSCReen, which that manual documents on page 463. Three entries were removed instead — *SAV, *RCL and *TST?. All three R&S manuals list the common commands they support and none of the three lists these, which fits R&S using MMEMory:STATe for save and recall. Every remaining entry can now be traced to one of the three manuals. Three common commands the RTA4000 manual documents were then added: *CAL? and *OPT?, each with an entry of its own, and *IST?, which all three manuals only name in passing and which carries a note saying so. Re-checked on 10 August 2026 against all three: 22 entries are absent from the RTB2000 manual this catalog names, and every one of the 22 is in the RTM3000 or the RTA4000 — the MEASurement<m>:GATE tree, CHANnel<m>:OVERload, TRIGger:A:LEVel<n>:HYSTeresis, DISPlay:INTensity:BACKlight, CURSor<m>:SSCReen and WGENerator:OUTPut:DESTination. Nothing is unaccounted for, and because all three manuals are kept in datasheets/ that is a settled result rather than an inference.
